title: MESSERS ANEES AND RAMPAL FRUIT COMPANY AND ORS versus THE DIRECTOR OF KIRISHI UTPADAN VIPPAN BOARD RUDRAPUR

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1058 of 2025 (M/S)
Messers Anees and Rampal Fruit Company
and others .....Petitioners

Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others .....Respondents
Present:-
Mr. Rajveer Singh, Advocate for the petitioners through video
conferencing.
Mr. R.S. Bisht, Addl. CSC for the State.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for the respondent no. 5.
JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
The petitioners are shopkeepers. It is their grievance
that respondent no. 5, the Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti, Rampur
Chungi, Roorkee has constructed 20 shops, which are to be allotted
in accordance with Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti Dukan/Godam
Aawantan Niyamawli, 2009 ("2009 Rules"), but the petitioners
apprehend that the allotment may not be done in accordance with
the 2009 Rules. The petitioners seek directions that the respondent
no. 5 may be directed to follow the provisions of 2009 Rules in
allotment of shops. One of the reliefs is that the petitioners have
made a representation to the respondent no. 5 on 26.03.2025 and
the respondent no. 5 may be directed to decide the representation
accordingly.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that
the respondent no. 5 has constructed 20 shops, which ought to
have been allotted under the provisions of 2009 Rules; but, the

2
petitioners apprehend that allotment may not be made in
accordance with 2009 Rules.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent no. 5
would submit that in the process of allotment of shops, the
provisions of 2009 Rules shall be followed in letter and spirit. He
would also submit that the representation given by the petitioners
dated 26.03.2025 (Annexure 1 to the writ petition) shall be decided
within a period of two weeks from today.
5. The Court takes on record the statement made by the
learned counsel for the respondent no. 5.
6. It cannot be pre-supposed that the respondent no. 5
will not make allotment as per the existing rules. Moreover, a
statement has been given that the allotment shall be made in
accordance with 2009 Rules.
7. In view of it, the writ petition is disposed of with the
direction to the respondent no. 5 to decide the representation of the
petitioners dated 26.03.2025 (Annexure 1 to the writ petition)
within two weeks from today.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J)
 30.04.2025
Avneet/
